QUOTE: The tables are generated by `scripts/generate_errors.pl`, so a new string is added by defining the error macro and regenerating the table, not by hand-editing `error.c`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says to define the macro and regenerate, but it never says the string comes from the `/** */` doc comment on the `#define`. Instead it says to add the description to separate generator data files, which is a different mechanism.
